what: `LinkInputs { base: None, tables: [] }` means two things: every table (none, when a build names none) and "the same snapshot as `serial`, nothing changed". A second link of one build gave the second, the launcher's driver read the first and wiped the program's span tables; the next first call stopped the program with `the build gave no span table of that anchor`.
cost: one debugging round on the VM (two builds, three runs), found only because a project was deleted and made again at the same path
cause: one field carries two cases; the doc on `LinkInputs` says only the first
workaround: the driver asks `work.whole` and compares `serial` with the one it holds (serve/unit/run/launch.rs)
state: open: give `LinkInputs` an enum (Same, Changed, Whole)
fix: open: give `LinkInputs` an enum (Same, Changed, Whole)
